p: I'm a recent graduate of NAIT in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. I play bass guitar and enjoy rock and metal music. When I'm not playing Dungeons & Dragons, computer games or Magic The Gathering, I'm usually asleep.
My name is pronounced like "kale," as in the vegetable. I think it might be useful to point out the differences between my phonetic doppleganger and myself.

div.div: When dropped on a keyboard, kale can hit random keys, but the results are not reliable.
I can type accurately on a keyboard and produce deliberate, working code.
Kale is able to photosynthesize sun light and create oxygen for the environment.
I graduated with honours from highschool and made the dean's list each year in college.
Kale is an excellent source of antioxidants, vitamins C and K, and beta-carotene.
I don't want to be eaten; that would be cannibalism.

br.small: Though it is a close race, I believe I would still be the better programming candidate.
